A provider can raise a database error from `DbDataReader.Read` or `NextResult` after `ExecuteReader` succeeds. These errors currently bypass `CommandFailed`, affecting both query enumeration and batched `SaveChanges`.

This change reports provider reader-advancement failures through the existing command failure callbacks, including sync, async, and buffered consumption. Cancellations use `CommandCanceled`. EF row materialization exceptions remain on the query-iteration path, and `QueryIterationFailed` is preserved.

Reporting accounts for ordinary `ILogger` logging, event-specific diagnostic listeners, and command interceptors independently. No supported public API is added.

## Validation
- Added 50 relational regression cases covering streaming and buffering, reads and result advancement, failures and cancellation, logging/diagnostics/interceptors, materialization exclusion, and reader disposal.
- Before the reporting-gate fix: 24 of those cases failed because events were missing; after the fix, all 50 pass.
- Relational command/reader suites: 157 passed, 0 failed.
- SQLite command-interception suite: 300 passed, 0 failed, including the actual `abs(long.MinValue)` reproduction in sync/async and streaming/buffered modes.
- Relational project build: 0 warnings and 0 errors.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

## Checklist
- [x] Read `.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [x] Added regression tests and used the documented commit format.
- [x] Local build and focused test suites pass.
- [ ] EF Core team feedback on the callback behavior change.
- [ ] Contributor License Agreement.
- [ ] GitHub automated build checks.
